blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu – The Lapu-Lapu City government will maintain modest Christmas and fiesta celebrations as part of its efforts to practice frugality amid the El Niño phenomenon while ensuring that planned activities remain inclusive and within budget. Mayor Cindi King-Chan said the city will not hold a grand Christmas party for all employees, similar to last year after Typhoon Tino. Instead, each department will hold simultaneous gatherings on Dec. 22 to avoid disrupting government services. The gatherings will be held between 2 p.m. and 3 p.m., allowing department heads and employees to come together and celebrate without incurring excessive expenses. […]...
